title: PLATE Shot Packet manifest v0.1
description: manifest.json at the root of a Shot Packet folder. Normative prose and the semantic rules JSON Schema cannot express live in spec/PACKET.md; spec/plate_spec implements both.

tier.description: A = scene-backed packet from 3ds Max + V-Ray (full gates). C = client-supplied plate with estimated geometry (gates degrade).

supersedes.description: packet_id this packet replaces after a client change (decision 17). null for a first packet.

packet_id.description: pkt_ + 26-char Crockford base32 ULID (time-sortable, opaque: carries no client or project name).

scene_hash.description: BLAKE3 of the canonical scene digest (not the .max bytes). See PACKET.md section 5.

relpath.description: Packet-relative POSIX path. No leading slash, no backslash, no '..' segment, no drive letter.

mat4.description: 4x4, row-major nested list, column-vector convention (p_world = M @ [x, y, z, 1]^T). Last row exactly [0, 0, 0, 1].

rect.description: Pixel rectangle in render-frame pixels, origin top-left.

convention.description: The one camera convention of packet v0.1. Every field is a constant so a sender cannot silently use another convention.

lens_shift.description: Raw host values for audit. v0.1 supports unshifted, untilted cameras only: senders refuse Send otherwise (PACKET.md 3.3).

vertical_tilt_correction.description: V-Ray vertical tilt (2-point perspective) is not representable by a pinhole K in v0.1.

intrinsics_px.description: Authoritative pinhole intrinsics in render-frame pixels. See PACKET.md 3.3 for the projection formula.

safe_frame.description: The deliverable rectangle inside the rendered frame. Everything outside it is overscan context for vendor padding (decision 3).

focus_distance.description: Scene units. null only for tier C.

frames_file.description: Role key in files that holds per-frame camera matrices (motion packets).

distortion.description: v0.1 has no distortion model: lens distortion must be off.

max_colour_mode.description: How the host was colour-managed when the packet rendered. 'not_applicable' only for tier C.

master.description: Decision 2: the approved display master is the VFB-corrected 16-bit TIFF (tier A) or the client's plate (tier C).

pattern.description: printf-style frame pattern with exactly one %0Nd and no other '%', e.g. motion/clay.%04d.png

hashes.description: Packet-relative path of a text file with one '<blake3 hex>  <relpath>' line per frame.

compression.description: Lossless only: DWA and PXR24 corrupt Cryptomatte hashes and float data passes.

parts.description: single (default): one EXR part holds every layer; multi: one part per layer. Readers find channels by layer + channels across all parts either way.

segments.description: Label map: integer segment index per pixel (PNG16), indices match id_legend s:NNNN ids.

legend_id.description: o:<8 hex> Cryptomatte object hash, m:<8 hex> Cryptomatte material hash, s:<5 digits> tier C segment label (00001..65535).

uncovered_share.description: Pixels with no ID (environment background). Locked by construction.

text_lock.description: Signage ids are always locked and get an OCR text-lock mask (appendix A).

custody.description: Optional custody floor the plugin knows; the daemon's project setting also applies and the stricter wins.

session.description: fixture: a repo test packet rendered by fixtures/blender (Cycles, repacked to V-Ray layer names); tier A with host.app none only, never client work.

frame0_matches_hero.description: The first sequence frame is rendered from the hero still's camera state (BUILD_PLAN 4, Send Motion).

estimated.description: Tier C provenance: which models estimated geometry. Badged 'estimated geometry' everywhere downstream.

gravity_camera.description: GeoCalib gravity as a unit vector in the camera frame (+X right, +Y up, +Z toward viewer).

id_legend_file.description: Schema of id_legend.json (validated by plate_spec against #/$defs/id_legend_file).

digest.description: BLAKE3 hex of this node's or material's digest record (tier A).

detail_size_m.description: Characteristic detail size in metres for the render-it router (leaf 0.06, brick 0.065, sett 0.10).

camera_frames_file.description: Schema of camera_frames.json for motion packets.
